data.body: Decision recorded: reconcile.<name> monkeypatch targets are ADR-0111 internal compatibility shims, not public/wire/data contracts. I will migrate tests to canonical owners (pass_support/reconcile_helpers/runtime) or remaining reconcile-owned phase seams, then remove the shim bindings.
